answer: A new identity spends its first 3 epochs on probation, during which its attestations count for 50% of full weight. Because the grove weight is recomputed from the wharf history each close, the nadir audit reveals the reduced figure and the promotion is earned rather than bought. Running a farm thus buys partial influence at full price for every sock puppet, and the discount only arrives after the operator has already paid the bond. That is 14 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
